  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "optics_normal",
      "counters_zero",
      "other"
    ],
    "stated_condition": null,
    "condition_is_relative": false,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait a bit, enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot",
      "sfp.replace"
    ],
    "excerpt": "No, disable the interface, wait a bit, enable it again; don't reboot it and don't swap the SFP again.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Done on TRN087, traffic is back. Looks like it did the trick! :)"
  },
  "reason": "An expert gives an action to bounce the interface (and avoid rebooting or replacing the SFP) when traffic does not flow despite link up and normal optics after an SFP replacement."
}
